run_yield_rollouts: run continuous Diplomacy game rollouts with CFR agents and yield RolloutResult batches
run_yield_game: generate Diplomacy games from JSON paths or create new standard games with optional phase sampling
run_queue_rollouts: queue rollout results into a multiprocessing queue for downstream training consumers
run_truncate_policy: truncate a power policy to a maximum number of actions and renormalize probabilities
run_average_policies: average a list of per-power action policies into a single combined policy
